settings.previewWritesHint: Review notes as old → new before saving, adjust them or cancel.

settings.separateVisionHint: Only if installed: analyse all image/scan pages one after another, then switch to the chat model. No parallel loading; later image tools use the chat model.
settings.separationHint: Profiles share neither database nor chats nor knowledge index. On a company computer, only the company profile can be set up.
settings.serverHint: Local addresses only while offline mode is active.
settings.sourceNotes: Save image and scan knowledge as searchable

settings.visionModelHint: Is not installed automatically. Without an available vision model the app uses the chat model if it supports images.
